purpose: Every theme scenario ADR-021 and UI/UX plan §12 require, with where each is proven. UI01-THEME-001 was a clean browser rendering DARK because the pre-hydration script consulted prefers-color-scheme; the first two rows are that defect, closed.
rule: Light is the default. The operating-system colour scheme is NEVER consulted. Dark is an explicit user choice and only an explicit user choice.

scenarios.condition: No stored preference; operating system prefers dark
proven_by: tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'a clean browser under a DARK operating system renders light' (Playwright colorScheme: 'dark')
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'still renders light when the operating system prefers dark' (asserts matchMedia is never CALLED)

scenarios.condition: No stored preference; operating system prefers light
proven_by: tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'a clean browser under a LIGHT operating system renders light'

scenarios.expected: dark, persisted per browser, applied at first paint after reload
proven_by: tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'an explicit dark choice persists across a reload'
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'persists an explicit choice per browser'

scenarios.condition: Anonymous visitor chooses light; operating system prefers dark
proven_by: tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'an explicit light choice persists under a dark operating system'

scenarios.expected: light — a malformed or removed value must not break a bootstrap
proven_by: tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'a malformed stored value falls back to light'
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'falls back to light for a malformed stored value'
tests/Feature/Auth/ThemePreferenceApiTest.php — 'resolves a malformed stored value to light rather than throwing'

scenarios.condition: Signed-in user whose record carries theme_preference = dark
scenarios.expected: dark applied BEFORE any authenticated content is visible, with no flash
scenarios.observed: The Laravel shell stamps data-sv-theme on <html>; the pre-hydration script reads it before Vue mounts.
proven_by: app/Http/Controllers/SpaShellController.php — themePreference() reads the session user only
tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'a server-rendered preference applies before hydration, with no flash'
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'adopts the attribute the Laravel shell stamped'

scenarios.condition: Signed-in user whose record carries theme_preference = light
scenarios.expected: light, overriding a conflicting stored browser value
scenarios.observed: The server record wins; the browser value is the fallback.
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'lets the server preference override this browser\'s choice'
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'lets the server attribute win over a conflicting stored value'

scenarios.condition: Signed-in user who has NEVER chosen; this browser has an explicit choice
scenarios.expected: the browser choice survives — a person who picked dark on this device should not lose it
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'keeps this browser\'s explicit choice when the user has no server preference'

scenarios.expected: PATCH /api/v1/auth/preferences writes to their OWN record; no permission key involved
proven_by: tests/Feature/Auth/ThemePreferenceApiTest.php — 'persists an explicit dark choice to the user record'
tests/Feature/Auth/ThemePreferenceApiTest.php — 'writes only the caller\'s own record, whatever the payload claims'
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'writes an explicit change to the user\'s own record'

scenarios.expected: the local theme is kept, and the control stops claiming it was saved
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'keeps the local theme but reports the failure when the server write fails'

scenarios.expected: the /me bootstrap adopts the server preference
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/authStore.ts — applyBootstrap()
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'applies the user\'s stored server preference on bootstrap'

scenarios.condition: A user switches account context to another host
scenarios.expected: the target host applies the SAME server preference
scenarios.observed: The target host loads a fresh page and runs /me, which adopts the same user record. No cross-host storage and no theme in a cookie or URL.
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/authStore.ts — applyBootstrap() runs on every host's bootstrap

scenarios.condition: A user logs out, leaving no explicit browser choice
scenarios.expected: the next user does NOT inherit the previous user's server preference
scenarios.observed: light; hasExplicitPreference recomputed from local storage alone
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'does not leak one user\'s server preference into the next session'

scenarios.condition: A user logs out, having deliberately chosen dark on this device
proven_by: resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.spec.ts — 'keeps a deliberate anonymous browser choice across logout'

scenarios.condition: The standalone SPA origin and the Laravel shell
scenarios.expected: byte-identical bootstrap scripts, neither consulting the operating system
scenarios.observed: identical; neither contains prefers-color-scheme or matchMedia
proven_by: tests/Feature/Hosts/AccountHostShellContractTest.php — 'keeps the two theme bootstraps byte-identical'
tests/Feature/Hosts/AccountHostShellContractTest.php — 'never lets the operating system select the theme in either shell (UI01-THEME-001)'
tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — 'the pre-hydration script never consults the operating system' (asserted on the SERVED document)

scenarios.expected: the theme class is set before Vue hydrates, so nothing flashes
scenarios.observed: The class is applied by the inline pre-hydration script; the store's initial resolution uses the SAME precedence, so hydration cannot change it.
proven_by: resources/spa/index.html and resources/views/spa.blade.php — inline bootstrap before the module script
resources/spa/src/stores/themeStore.ts — resolveInitial() mirrors the bootstrap precedence exactly
tests/Feature/DesignSystem/DesignTokenGenerationTest.php — 'never consults prefers-color-scheme anywhere in the generated CSS'

scenarios.expected: rejected at validation AND at the database CHECK
scenarios.observed: 422 at the boundary; QueryException at the database
proven_by: tests/Feature/Auth/ThemePreferenceApiTest.php — 'rejects any value outside the closed light/dark vocabulary'
tests/Feature/Auth/ThemePreferenceApiTest.php — 'refuses a value the database vocabulary does not permit'
tests/Feature/Auth/ThemePreferenceApiTest.php — 'offers no way to express "follow the operating system"'

scenarios.condition: Every semantic token pair in both themes
scenarios.expected: AA text contrast, 3:1 non-text contrast, visible focus
scenarios.observed: 35 computed contrast requirements pass in BOTH themes; axe reports 0 serious and 0 critical in light and dark
proven_by: tests/Feature/DesignSystem/DesignTokenContrastTest.php
tests/e2e/ui-04-design-system.spec.ts — axe light and dark
